title: Landscape of Life, Life of Landscape - The Role and Importance of Landscape in Art
content:
The protection of the landscape in accordance with the European Landscape Convention can be realized, among other things, by showing and disseminating the beauty, meanings, and impressions of landscape perception that define the values of native landscapes that we experience in our daily lives. One of the media creating such a message is art. The questions that arise, however, are whether artists deal with landscape in contemporary works of visual art? If so, what dimensions of landscape and its values are captured in their works.
These questions became the impetus for organizing the exhibition" Landscape of Life, Life of Landscape'' (Tuczno Castle), which, due to the theme taken up, brought together 36 artists, who are authors of nearly 80 works from various fields. The artists tried to convey their way of perceiving the value of the landscape along with the processes occurring in it.
The works collected at the exhibition became the material subjected to formal and semantic analysis and classified in terms of the spatial values fixed in them according to Królikowski (2010). The result of the analysis is the thesis that landscape is a frequently taken theme and inspiration for contemporary creative activities in the field of visual arts. In the analyzed works of painting, sculpture, photography, film and spatial installations, one notices abstract shots aiming to articulate artistic, aesthetic and symbolic values to realistic shots highlighting sacred, historical, social, individual, local, national, universal values and, finally, landscape and natural values.
